paladin golden plaintext v1

This small, fixed file is the plaintext behind every ciphertext in
tests/fixtures/golden/. Decrypting any golden with the documented golden
password must reproduce these exact bytes — that is how the suite proves a
newer build still reads containers written by an older one.

Keep this file stable. Changing it invalidates every committed golden and
forces a deliberate, reviewed regeneration (see README.md in this directory).
